learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to count fun things up to 20 and find out exactly how many there are!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we want to know how many toys we have, we count them one by one! We can count numbers from 10 to 20.
Ten loose matchsticks together make one big bundle. One bundle of 10 and one loose stick makes 11!
Look at two baskets of apples. We count them to see which basket has more apples and which has less.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Kitchen Bean Counting!
fun_activity.instructions: Ask Mummy for some dry beans or rajma. Count exactly 15 beans loudly and put them in a small bowl!

quick_recap: ⭐ We can count things to find out exactly how many there are.
⭐ We know how to make a bundle of 10 and count all the way up to 20!
